_meta.description: 200 body of POST /api/invites/{inviteId}/resend (rest-api.md §7.5.4) — the PATH row after a re-mint. `inviteId` is UNCHANGED (a client holding it keeps working) and `createdAt` is UNCHANGED (the owner's 'sent {ago}' line still refers to the original send); only `code` and `expiresAt` move. Every sibling row sharing the previous code was re-minted in the SAME transaction and carries this same new code.
